scope: Investigate and write one narrative for each of the four existing cultural-attribution leads.
review_findings: Four complete narratives separate different kinds of cultural claim.
Jayadeva manuscript, literary and archaeological evidence explicitly bounded.
Digha contains both stated positions and dated announcement; implementation remains unverified.
Chhau parliamentary records distinguish a member’s claims from ministerial answers.
Sambalpur chronology uses attributed year-level accounts; no fabricated newspaper quotation.
Opening scenes are source-grounded description or expressly labelled thought experiment.
limitations: No independent historian, practitioner or language review.
Some government magazine passages were available only in indexed text.
Underlying manuscripts, excavation records, original correspondence and colonial orders remain unexamined where specified.
No field visit, newly collected interview or documentary image selection.
